import ctypes, json, sys, time, random, itertools

from netnomos.finite import compile_job

    t0 = time.time(); t1 = time.process_time()
    out = [compile_job(j) for j in jobs]
    print(f'{label}: wall {time.time()-t0:.2f}s cpu {time.process_time()-t1:.2f}s',
          'rules', [len(o['rules']) for o in out], 'bytes',
          len(json.dumps({'results': out})))
    return out

# ---- stress 1: maximal discovery search tree (32 predicates, width 4) ----
dom = list(range(32))
preds = [{'kind': 'all', 'field': 'x', 'op': 'ne', 'value': v} for v in range(32)]
rows = [list(t) for t in itertools.combinations(range(32), 3)]
train = rows[:]
while len(train) < 10000:
    train.append(rows[len(train) % len(rows)])
